methods.expected_maximum: Numerical expectation from the normal maximum quantile function using 128-point Gaussian quadrature.
methods.maximum_interval: Pointwise 95% predictive interval using P(maximum <= x)=Phi((x-mean)/sd)^n; allows 0.01 grade points for rounding.
methods.selection: Graduate-weighted top-20% cutoff within university-year, with at least four observed fields. Same records and weights for both distributions.
methods.truncation: Restricts the existing normal to [5,10], retaining its underlying location and scale. Truncation changes the resulting mean and IQR; parameters are not refitted.

limitations: Published summaries cannot establish normality or support an individual-level normality test.
Mean-median gaps are descriptive evidence of asymmetry, not a formal significance test.
Maximum diagnostics assume independent grades and treat estimated means, scales and matched graduate counts as known; intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
Missing fields are excluded; selection represents graduates in available fields, not necessarily the complete university.
Selection compares model-implied rates, not the identities of individual selected students.
